question: How do I export a note as PDF?
reference_answer: Open the note, click Share and choose Export as PDF.

question: Can I export my notes to Markdown?
reference_answer: Yes: Share > Export as Markdown; bulk export is on Pro and Team.

question: How do I resolve a sync conflict?
reference_answer: Both versions are kept; compare the 'Conflicted copy' with the original and delete the one you don't need.

question: How long is version history kept on the Free plan?
reference_answer: 7 days.

question: How do I restore a deleted note from the Trash?
reference_answer: Open Trash, select the note and click Restore, within 30 days.

question: What does the Team plan cost per user?
reference_answer: $10 per user per month.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
reference_answer: Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

question: What is the refund policy for yearly subscriptions?
reference_answer: Full refund within 14 days of purchase.

question: Is there a student discount?
reference_answer: Yes, 50% off Pro, verified with a school email.

question: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
reference_answer: Settings > Security; authenticator apps and hardware keys are supported.

question: How long is the password reset link valid?
reference_answer: 1 hour.

question: Which browsers does the web clipper support?
reference_answer: Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari.

question: How do I create a note from a template?
reference_answer: New > From template.

question: Can I import my Evernote notes?
reference_answer: Yes, import .enex files via Settings > Data > Import.

question: What is the maximum attachment size on Pro?
reference_answer: 200 MB per attachment.

question: Can Team workspaces use EU data residency?
reference_answer: Yes, chosen when the workspace is created; it can't be changed later.

question: What is the keyboard shortcut for the quick switcher?
reference_answer: Cmd/Ctrl+K.

question: Do AI summaries use my notes to train models?
reference_answer: No, summaries are never used to train AI models.

question: My laptop has no wifi on the plane, can I still write?
reference_answer: Yes, the desktop app works offline and syncs edits when you reconnect.

question: I edited the same page on my phone and my computer and now there are two of them, why?
reference_answer: It's a sync conflict; both versions are kept as the note and a 'Conflicted copy'.

question: I messed up a paragraph yesterday, can I go back to what it said before?
reference_answer: Yes, use version history (clock icon) to preview and restore an earlier version.

question: I accidentally binned something last week, is it gone forever?
reference_answer: No, it stays in Trash for 30 days and can be restored.

question: How much money is the paid tier if I pay once a year?
reference_answer: Pro is $6 per month billed yearly.

question: If I stop paying, will I lose everything I wrote?
reference_answer: No, notes are never deleted; the account moves to Free at the end of the period.

question: I bought the annual plan by mistake three days ago, can I get my money back?
reference_answer: Yes, yearly plans are fully refundable within 14 days.

question: I'm at university, is it cheaper for me?
reference_answer: Yes, students get 50% off Pro.

question: It won't let me log in on my new tablet, says too many devices
reference_answer: Free allows 3 devices; sign out of one under Settings > Account > Devices or upgrade.

question: I lost my phone with the authenticator app, how do I get back in?
reference_answer: Use your backup codes; otherwise support verifies your identity, which can take up to 5 business days.

question: Can your employees read my private journal?
reference_answer: Locked notes are end-to-end encrypted and staff cannot read them; all notes are encrypted in transit and at rest.

question: How do I let a coworker edit my project notes?
reference_answer: On Team, share the notebook with them as an Editor.

question: Can I save a news article from Chrome straight into my notes?
reference_answer: Yes, with the web clipper browser extension.

question: Can I find words that are inside a scanned receipt photo?
reference_answer: Yes, on Pro and Team search covers text inside images.

question: Is there a way to get a quick TL;DR of a really long meeting write-up?
reference_answer: Yes, use Summarize (AI summaries) on Pro and Team.

question: I'm moving from Notion, can I bring my pages?
reference_answer: Yes, import Notion's Markdown export via Settings > Data > Import.

question: I want all my data wiped from your servers
reference_answer: Delete the account in Settings > Account > Delete account; it's processed within 30 days.

question: Are my files kept in Europe?
reference_answer: By default data is in the US; Team workspaces can choose EU residency at creation.

question: Does Lumen Notes have a Linux desktop app?
reference_answer: Not covered by the knowledge base.

question: Can I pay with PayPal?
reference_answer: Not covered by the knowledge base.

question: Is there an API for developers?
reference_answer: Not covered by the knowledge base.

question: Can I record audio notes?
reference_answer: Not covered by the knowledge base.
